---
name: Dataset Issue / Anomaly Report
about: Report a data quality issue, license question, or annotation anomaly
title: '[DATASET] '
labels: ['dataset', 'quality']
assignees: ''
---

**Dataset / Source Involved**
- Source Name: [e.g. CORE_RPLAN, CORE_IL3D, CORE_RESBIM_PAIRED, CORE_NORMES_FR, etc.]
- Split: [train / validation / test / review]
- Asset / Record ID(s):

**Type of Issue**
- [ ] Metric calibration anomaly (e.g. pixels mislabeled as m²)
- [ ] Data leakage between splits or projects
- [ ] License / redistribution restriction
- [ ] Annotation error or inconsistency
- [ ] Corrupted file / decoding error
- [ ] Multimodal mismatch (fake multimodal pair)

**Detailed Description**
Describe the observed defect and provide evidence (hashes, values, code snippet).

**Proposed Remediation**
Should this record be quarantined, repaired, or discarded?
